_comment: This is the FULLY LOCAL profile: the Service Bus emulator and Azurite, no Azure
resources and no credentials. ServiceBusConnection is a plain connection string here;
deployed it is ServiceBusConnection__fullyQualifiedNamespace with no secret at all.
AzureClientFactory is the single place that decides between the two (SPEC.md 12.1).
To run locally against real Azure instead, replace the two connection values with
and drop AzureWebJobsStorage. That path authenticates as your az login, which needs the
Service Bus data-plane roles Terraform assigns to the operator - subscription Owner alone
